artboards.title: The inbox — one place, every space
How a live agent gets made

annotations.text:
EVERY ITEM CARRIES ITS EVIDENCE

Stolen from conflict.rs, which already says it:
"Detection is heuristic and says so… a conflict
centre that cries wolf gets ignored."

So the inbox never just asserts. It shows what it
saw, and every item can be told to stop watching.

THREE OF THE FIVE NEED NO CLOCK

An agent finishing, an approval, a project changing
— all events on the bus you already have.

Only the deadline and the neglected routine need
time, and neglect is the absence of events: one
daily sweep, not a general scheduler.
